# Support

## Before Opening An Issue

Please check:

- [README.md](../README.md)
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)
- [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md)

If the issue is about downloads, please try to include:

- app version
- Android version and device
- source site
- whether it is a single file or playlist
- whether cookies or YouTube access were used
- any relevant error text or log excerpt

## Where To Ask For What

### Bug reports

Use the bug-report issue template for:

- download failures
- queue or history regressions
- update/runtime problems
- localization mistakes
- UI behavior bugs

### Feature requests

Use the feature-request template for:

- focused improvements
- workflow refinements
- translation or documentation improvements
- practical developer tooling suggestions

### Security issues

Do not open a public issue for active vulnerabilities or sensitive data leaks.
Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) instead.

## Project Posture

This app is currently in a stable `1.7.2` phase. Near-term work is expected to
focus more on:

- reliability
- download/runtime compatibility
- translation quality
- documentation accuracy
- internal logic hardening

and less on large structural UI redesigns.
